bootstrap_unit: Independent generator seed; paired cluster resampling across methods
ci: Percentile paired bootstrap 95%; exploratory with only five clusters
test: Exact two-sided paired sign-flip test on per-seed F1 differences
limitations: Only five independent synthetic seeds; bootstrap CIs may be unstable

Heuristic baselines are not published SOTA methods
